objective: Close M08.15 as an executable gate: the Workstation / Infrastructure bundle's two delivery forms and its extension seam over ONE daemon-owned machine lifecycle. The daemon answers the machine family's read model (inventory and per-workload spine — head, desired/observed generations and phases, the bound declaration, operations in chain order, receipts, cleanup obligations) derived from its records on every read, and admits a proposal under a resolved principal only, recording the submitter as it resolved it. The App projects that read model member for member and derives nothing; its lane relays the daemon's answer verbatim. A thin client over the daemon's API is the standalone form in this cut. An ODK-authored extension admitted through Packages renders only the public read model and offers its declared action without invoking.
